INSERT INTO investigator_pre_details (survey_info_id,investigator_re_id,investigator_case_id,Investigator_re_money) SELECT c.survey_info_id , #{preReId}, i.id, ROUND(sum(IFNULL( c.medical_history_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( c.troubleshooting_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( c.opc_troubleshooting_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( c.printing_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( c.accommodatio_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( c.cross_driving_money, 0 ) + IFNULL( c.self_driving_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( c.other_money, 0 )+ IFNULL( c.toll_money, 0 )),2) Investigator_re_money FROM survey_user_clock u LEFT JOIN survey_clock_case c ON u.id = c.clock_id LEFT JOIN survey_investigator_case i ON c.survey_info_id = i.survey_info_id WHERE u.survey_user_id = #{userId} and u.survey_org_id = #{orgId} AND DATE_FORMAT( u.clock_time, '%Y-%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m') AND i.survey_user_id = u.survey_user_id AND c.id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.survey_info_id
